definitions.explanation: The head as a part of the body, in medical, scientific and news language. Also the top or front part of an object, such as a doll or a missile.

examples.japanese: {頭部|とうぶ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{強|つよ}く→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧⟦{打|う}った→打つ：01221_utsu⟧。
{頭部|とうぶ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦けが→けが：00787_kega⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{入院|にゅういん}した→入院する：01849_nyuuinsuru⟧。
examples.english: She was hospitalized with a head injury.

examples.japanese: ⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧、⟦{念|ねん}のため→念のため：16746_nennotame⟧{頭部|とうぶ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧CT⟦{検査|けんさ}→検査：02707_kensa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧ことになった。
examples.english: After the accident, I was to have a CT scan of my head, just to be safe.

notes:
The formal equivalent of ⟦{頭|あたま}→頭：00574_atama⟧, used in medical reports, news of accidents and sports injuries, and descriptions of animals or objects. Compare ⟦{腹部|ふくぶ}→腹部：21667_fukubu⟧ (abdomen), ⟦{胸部|きょうぶ}→胸部：27436_kyoubu⟧ (chest) and {腰部|ようぶ} (lower back).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {頭部|とうぶ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{打|う}つ→打つ：01221_utsu⟧: to hit one's head
- {頭部|とうぶ}⟦{外傷|がいしょう}→外傷：12148_gaishou⟧: head injury
- ⟦{後頭部|こうとうぶ}→後頭部：19509_koutoubu⟧: the back of the head
- {頭部|とうぶ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{検査|けんさ}→検査：02707_kensa⟧: a head examination
